_comment: Pinned EXACT lines that name a banned QA-input technique in order to FORBID it, plus the single-checkout deploy steps in the justfile (scripts/check-qa-input-safety.mjs). Matching is rule + exact trimmed line text, so a new occurrence fails even inside an allowlisted file, and a pinned line that disappears fails as stale. Never add an entry to make a fresh instruction green — these techniques reached the user's production vault once (M24) and killed three peer worktrees' dev stacks once (M25).
